statement: Pinned hid-nintendo declares output reports 0x01 (rumble plus subcommand), 0x10 (rumble only), 0x80 (USB command) and input 0x21 (subcommand reply), 0x30 (IMU), 0x3F (button), 0x81 (USB response).

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Kernel source enumerates recognized IDs; this alone does not show retail report prevalence or firmware-level support.
